name: factory
description: Run herdr software factories through this session: it ticks every run, patrols the factory as its manager, and draws a live console.

autopilot.title: Let the manager model drive the factory
autopilot.description: On: this session's model patrols the factory. It is woken by mail for the manager (a stuck station, a worker's question, a gate, a finished run), by a worker blocked on a prompt, and every 10 minutes while workers run or a rig with a goal has room, and acts on them. Off: mail only shows in the pane and a toast.
